items.title: Lloyd's appoints former PwC insurance head to Council as WTW names French aviation lead
items.summary: Lloyd's has named Stephen O'Hearn as an independent nominated non-executive member of its Council, while WTW has appointed Jean-Pascal Mouchette to lead its aviation business in France.

items.title: Dynagas seeks replacement marine insurance for two Russian-chartered LNG carriers ahead of UK ban
items.summary: Dynagas LNG Partners is scrambling to secure protection and indemnity and hull cover for two ice-class LNG carriers before UK sanctions bar British insurers from Russian LNG voyages.

items.title: Over one third of pension transfers to potential green list schemes trigger scam warnings
items.summary: XPS Group analysis shows that over a third of pension transfers directed towards potentially reputable schemes raised scam warning flags.

items.title: Clear Group acquires London high net worth and real estate broker Alexander Miller
items.summary: Clear Group has expanded its portfolio by acquiring independent broker Alexander Miller, with founder Melanie Hampton remaining to lead the business.

items.title: UK businesses voice supply chain conflict fears, but few take action
items.summary: Intact Insurance's first Business Resilience Index reveals that while concerns over international conflict disrupting supply chains have nearly tripled, only around a quarter of UK firms have taken defensive steps.

items.title: UK insurers' solvency held firm in PRA live stress test but relied heavily on reinsurance and group support
items.summary: The Prudential Regulation Authority's first real-time crisis drill showed all 25 participating general insurers maintained their solvency requirements, though combined shocks would have breached internal risk-appetite limits without external rescue actions.
